cases.id: control: a key answer under another run's key is ignored
widgets-tabs-fail: div tabs take no focus and ignore ArrowRight, so neither focusMoved nor ariaSelectedMoved holds (two findings)
control: widgets-tabs-pass moves focus and aria-selected to the next tab, so no finding
widgets-roles-fail: ArrowDown in the menu moves nothing (focusMoved)
control: widgets-roles-pass ArrowDown moves focus inside the menu
widgets-roles-fail: Escape leaves the menu open (expandedFalse)
control: widgets-roles-pass Escape closes the menu
widgets-roles-fail: the dialog opens but focus stays outside (focusInside)
control: widgets-roles-pass moves focus into the dialog
widgets-roles-fail: Escape does not close the dialog (expandedFalse; focus never left the trigger, so focusReturned holds)
control: widgets-roles-pass Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger
widgets-roles-fail: ArrowDown in the combobox opens nothing and sets no active descendant
control: widgets-roles-pass ArrowDown opens the popup and sets the active descendant
widgets-roles-fail: ArrowDown in the listbox moves neither focus nor the active descendant (any of two)
control: widgets-roles-pass ArrowDown moves the active descendant
a pattern with another step presses its next key
control: after the last step the page is restored
a restored page starts the next widget
